```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

# --- Helper: Get Value safely ---
get_val <- function(df, key) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (!"Metric" %in% names(df) || !"Value" %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
  
  val <- df$Value[df$Metric == key]
  if (length(val) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(val)
}

# --- Helper: Generate List Text ---
generate_list_text <- function(df, exclude_keys = c()) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return("")
  if (!"Metric" %in% names(df) || !"Value" %in% names(df)) return("")
  
  leftover <- df %>% filter(!Metric %in% exclude_keys)
  if (nrow(leftover) == 0) return("")
  
  text_parts <- paste0("<b>", leftover$Metric, "</b>: ", leftover$Value)
  return(paste(text_parts, collapse = "; "))
}
```

# `r params$school_name`

</h1> <p style="color: #666; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.2em; margin-top: 0;"> Executive Summary generated by STRIDE </p> <hr style="border-top: 3px solid #FFB81C; width: 60%; margin-top: 20px;"> </div>

1. School Profile

```{r}
df <- params$df_basic

# Check for data using standard R operators (&&)
if (!is.null(df) && is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
  id <- get_val(df, "School ID")
  head_name <- get_val(df, "School Head")
  pos <- get_val(df, "Position")
  type <- get_val(df, "Typology")
  coc <- get_val(df, "Curricular Offering")
  
  txt <- paste0("<b>", params$school_name, "</b>")
  if (!is.null(id)) txt <- paste0(txt, " (School ID: ", id, ")")
  
  txt <- paste0(txt, " is currently categorized as a ")
  if (!is.null(type)) txt <- paste0(txt, "<b>", type, "</b> school") else txt <- paste0(txt, "school")
  
  if (!is.null(coc)) txt <- paste0(txt, " offering <b>", coc, "</b>.") else txt <- paste0(txt, ".")
  
  if (!is.null(head_name)) {
    txt <- paste0(txt, " The school is currently managed by <b>", head_name, "</b>")
    if (!is.null(pos)) txt <- paste0(txt, " (", pos, ").") else txt <- paste0(txt, ".")
  }
  
  mun <- get_val(df, "Municipality")
  brgy <- get_val(df, "Barangay")
  div <- get_val(df, "Division")
  
  if (!is.null(mun)) {
    txt <- paste0(txt, " It is strategically located in ")
    if (!is.null(brgy)) txt <- paste0(txt, "Barangay ", brgy, ", ")
    txt <- paste0(txt, "<b>", mun, "</b>")
    if (!is.null(div)) txt <- paste0(txt, " under the Division of ", div, ".") else txt <- paste0(txt, ".")
  }
  
  cat(paste0(txt, "\n\n"))
} else {
  cat("<i>No basic profile data available.</i>\n\n")
}
```


2. Enrolment Overview
```{r}
df <- params$df_enrol

if (!is.null(df) && is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
  total <- get_val(df, "Total Enrolment")
  txt <- ""
  if (!is.null(total)) {
    txt <- paste0("The school has a total recorded student population of <b>", total, "</b> learners. ")
  } else {
    txt <- "Enrolment breakdown is as follows: "
  }
  
  breakdown <- generate_list_text(df, exclude_keys = c("Total Enrolment"))
  if (breakdown != "") {
    txt <- paste0(txt, "The distribution across grade levels is: ", breakdown, ".")
  }
  cat(paste0(txt, "\n\n"))
} else {
  cat("<i>No enrolment records found.</i>\n\n")
}
```

4. Infrastructure & Resources
```{r}
df <- params$df_infra

if (!is.null(df) && is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
  classrooms <- get_val(df, "Total Classrooms")
  buildings <- get_val(df, "Total Buildings")
  shortage <- get_val(df, "Estimated Shortage")
  
  txt <- "Regarding physical facilities, the school inventory reports "
  if (!is.null(classrooms)) txt <- paste0(txt, "<b>", classrooms, "</b> instructional rooms ")
  if (!is.null(buildings)) txt <- paste0(txt, "housed within <b>", buildings, "</b> buildings. ")
  
  if (!is.null(shortage)) {
    s_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(shortage))
    if (!is.na(s_num) && s_num > 0) {
      txt <- paste0(txt, "Current analysis suggests a shortage of <b>", shortage, "</b> classrooms based on standard parameters. ")
    } else {
      txt <- paste0(txt, "There is currently no estimated classroom shortage. ")
    }
  }
  
  details <- generate_list_text(df, exclude_keys = c("Total Classrooms", "Total Buildings", "Estimated Shortage"))
  if (details != "") {
    txt <- paste0(txt, "<br><br>Additional facility status: ", details, ".")
  }
  cat(paste0(txt, "\n\n"))
} else {
  cat("<i>No infrastructure data recorded.</i>\n\n")
}
```
